changes.name: release
changes.impact: Nothing is synced for it: the platform's record and the labels of its objects name the new release.

changes.name: cert-manager
changes.impact: cert-manager moves to the new chart version. ArgoCD applies its CRDs in place (v1 stays the only version) and removes what the new chart no longer renders. Each of the controller, cainjector and webhook Deployments starts its new pod and removes the old one only when the new one is Ready; the three roll together. The wave waits until ArgoCD reports the three Deployments rolled (Healthy against the new chart) and the sync, the chart's startupapicheck Job included, Succeeded. Certificates and their Secrets stay. On a lab (one sample) the run took 3 minutes 8 seconds, about a minute and a half per cluster, no Certificate was issued again and no webhook refused a request; a one-node seed's API was slow for about half a minute while it pulled the new images. The webhooks of Cluster API and Kamaji keep their certificates. No pod of a tenant restarts, no machine is replaced and nothing is written on Proxmox, so no seed backup is needed. There is no way back: a platform does not go back to a BOM, and cert-manager documents no downgrade; its upgrade guide advises a backup of the cert-manager resources first (kubectl get certificates,issuers,clusterissuers -A -o yaml on the seed and on the platform cluster).
